findings.reason: The protected Python is clear, conventional, and expert-interview ready. parent and size expose union-find state, find names representative lookup directly, city_a/city_b/cost state each edge role, root_a/root_b distinguish endpoints from components, and total/used remain local to the minimum-spanning-tree scan. Path halving, union by size, early completion, and the disconnected fallback are expressed without opaque helpers or unnecessary abstraction; no material improvement warrants a candidate.

Connections are processed in nondecreasing cost order. An edge with different endpoint roots is a cheapest available edge crossing the cut between two current components, so the minimum-spanning-tree cut property makes that merge safe; equal roots identify a cycle edge that cannot improve connectivity. Union-find therefore tracks exactly the components induced by selected edges. Reaching n - 1 merges yields a minimum spanning tree, while fewer merges after all edges proves that the graph is disconnected and requires -1.
